description: Improve GSAP MCP server with better tool descriptions, parameter enrichment, new tools, bug fixes, and knowledge base updates so AI models produce optimal GSAP code

userStories.title: Add server-level instructions to McpServer constructor
userStories.description: As an AI model consumer, I want the MCP server to provide global instructions during initialize so that I know the rules and tool selection guide upfront.
acceptanceCriteria: McpServer constructor in src/index.ts includes an 'instructions' field with the full instructions text from the design spec (GSAP v3.12+ rules, tool selection guide)
Instructions include NEVER/ALWAYS rules for v2 syntax, imports, registerPlugin, duration placement, autoAlpha, gsap.context
Instructions include the complete TOOL SELECTION GUIDE mapping animation tasks to tool names
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: This is the instructions field in the McpServer constructor options. See design spec Section 1 for the exact text.

Non-callback string values (CSS values, easing names) remain properly quoted
Add regression tests in tests/generators/templates.test.ts for callback raw expression passthrough

Tests pass
userStories.notes: Bug fix in src/generators/templates.ts formatValue function. Also check onUpdate in counter preset at src/tools/core/presets.ts ~line 369.

userStories.title: Fix controls selector parameter misnamed to variableName
userStories.description: As an AI model, I want the controls parameter to be named variableName so I know it expects a JS variable name, not a CSS selector.
acceptanceCriteria: Zod schema key in src/tools/dev/controls.ts renamed from 'selector' to 'variableName'
variableName has describe: 'JavaScript variable name of the tween or timeline to control, e.g. tl, heroAnimation. NOT a CSS selector.'
Backward compatibility: Zod .transform() accepts old 'selector' key and maps to variableName
When old 'selector' name is used, output includes a deprecation comment
Update tests/tools/controls.test.ts for the variableName rename
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Rename in src/tools/dev/controls.ts. Must maintain backward compatibility via .transform().

Plugin tools mention the required plugin import in the comment
Comments are 1-2 lines max
Add tests in tests/generators/code-builder.test.ts for the new method

Tests pass
userStories.notes: New method on existing class in src/generators/code-builder.ts. Tool handlers will call this in later stories.
